text:
Aisha: Quick sync — launching the Hack Day refapp next week. Need: blog post, step-by-step tutorial, 30-min webinar, short benchmark narrative, and inbound lead routing. Timeline: Tue public launch, Wed webinar. Who owns which asset?
Liam: I can run the webinar + demo. Need slides + a 10-min benchmark section. Can we get sample prompts and perf numbers?
Priya: I'll draft the blog and the tutorial step-by-step. Repo link + hero screenshot would help. Also can do two short social copy variants.
Mateo: Growth will build the landing + forms. For routing, prefer HubSpot. Suggested workflow: source=hackday, campaign=refapp-hackday -> route to SDR queue "hackday-inbound". Can do webhook fallback.
Omar: I'll own the 1-click deploy/quickstart. Plan: add Dockerfile + CloudFormation template + demo env. ETA: EOD Wed for a basic quickstart.
Aisha: Messaging priorities: "plug-and-play inference", "production-ready observability", and a clear cost comparison vs naive self-hosting. Keep blurbs short.
Priya: Social snippets ready — two tweet variants, one LinkedIn. Example draft: "Ship LLM features faster with Redwood's Hack Day RefApp — 1-click deploy, practical benchmarks, and a hands-on tutorial. Try it: <landing link>". Want shorter headline for the blog.
Liam: Webinar runbook: 1) 3m intro 2) 12m demo 3) 8m benchmark deep-dive 4) 7m live Q&A. Add poll: "Are you self-hosting?". Need speakers and a backup demo video.
Mateo: We should A/B test CTAs: CTA-A "Try the RefApp" vs CTA-B "Watch the Webinar". Track CVR and lead quality for both.
Aisha: Action items — Priya: blog+tutorial draft by Thu noon; Liam: slides + demo run-through by Thu EOD; Omar: quickstart & templates by Wed; Mateo: landing + HubSpot form+routing by Wed EOD. I'll own launch email + PR outreach.
Priya: Got it. I'll ping @eng-design for the hero screenshot.
Liam: Can someone share a short benchmark blurb for slides? e.g., "2x cost reduction vs naive batching" — need exact numbers.
Omar: Ran a quick perf pass this morning — local: p50 45ms with batching vs 92ms naive; raw cost per 1k tokens ~$0.85 vs ~$1.90 naive. I'll add the spreadsheet link in #eng-runtime.
Mateo: HubSpot form -> webhook if needed. Example webhook endpoint (staging): https://hooks.redwood.ai/hackday-2026 . Use UTM params: utm_source=hackday&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=refapp
Aisha: Great. Quick sync tomorrow 10:00am to verify assets and finalize copy. :thumbsup:
jen-bot: Calendar reminder created for 2026-03-22 10:00 — "Hack Day RefApp launch assets sync".
Liam: I'll record a 5-min backup demo video in case live demo flakes.
Priya: I'll post the first blog draft in this thread when ready for review.
Mateo: Will set up tracking and shortlink once landing is live.
Aisha: Thanks everyone — love the momentum. We'll reconvene after the sync.
